topic: Kubernetes Deployments: how desired state, ReplicaSets and rolling updates work
goals: Predict what a Deployment controller does after a change to replicas or the Pod template
Explain why a rolling update stalls when new Pods never become ready
Choose readiness settings for a simple web service
scope: Concepts and manifests only; no live cluster required

intake.capability: Read a Deployment manifest and predict the rollout and its failure modes

learner.startingKnowledge: Uses Docker and docker compose; has never operated Kubernetes

practice.realWorld: no cluster available; simulations and manifests only
